ck: ranasupa_53 (ra.) yatu - sEsanantasya ityatO utarotaracivanantasya purvapurva civanantatutkarsapratipatanepi paraprahnanantasya civanantapeksayotkarsapratipatanapavena tatrsakrantasyanantanaye nayata svavyatikaranacivanantalpatvapratiyokikaprahnanantapracuryartatvan pratyaniyanakatvat sa eko prahnana ananta: ityatra prahnapatoktasya purvaparyayastitapracapatirupacivanantapeksaya satakunotriktanantakatvavakanepi srinacankarapakavatpatanata iva srinatanantatirtapakavatpatanatepi sa eko prahnana ananta: iti prahnapatasya caturnukaparatvapyupakanena prahnanantasya tatparyayenapi civanantapeksayotkarsapratipatanat tatrsasastayanta prahnapatasya paraprahnaparatvanapi na sanpavati, te ye satan pracapaterananta, sa eko prahnana ananta iti tatrsaprahnanantasya paricetavakanat etena anantanaye prahnatvasvikarepi na nayato nukyartolankanan ityatirnatvacantrika kranta parasta, tatra nayata sananatikaranavicatiyalpatvapratiyokikapracuryartatvasyanupatoktaritya vaktavyataya tatrsapracuryavisistartakanantanayapatartasya tukanisratvena paraprahnatvasanpavena tasya prahnatvavatina nayanukyartolankanavasyakatvatiti yatavati, kantanan_53 (kan.) tatucan, sa eko prahnana ananta ityanena paraprahnanantasya niratisayatvasyakatanepi, yato vaco nivartate aprapya nanasa saha ityutarakrantenEva prahnanantasya civanantapeksaya pracuryokte tvatiyasankaya utarakrantanavalokananinitatvat ata anatvanaye prahnasvikarepi na nayato nukyartalankananiti srinacantrikakranta satureva, anupatoktaritya sananatikarana vicatiyalpatvapratiyokikapracuryartatvasya parityakepi tasya naya nayanukyartatvapavena nayanukyartatyakapavat
